exact_target_signature: For a finite index type I, real weights w with 0<=w_i, Option-real values v, threshold t, define K={i | exists x, v_i=some x and t<x} and U={i | v_i=none}. For any completion event E satisfying K subset E and E subset K union U, prove sum_K w <= sum_E w <= sum_K w + sum_U w. Preserve strict inequality t<x, with equality excluded by definition.
acceptance: works for empty K/U and zero weights
does not renormalize by defined mass
upper bound need not use sum w=1
theorem type exposes all inclusion hypotheses
scope: Finite real weighted event inclusion bridge. It models the implementation's known/undefined mass interval, but does not formalize Python floating point, arbitrary measurable spaces, attainment/sharpness, or full PORT-CAS-07.
handoff_rule: Return to lead if a measure-theoretic or completion-attainability definition is required; do not invent it.
